# Variant exposition: some vLLM metric names simply absent.
# Only waiting and the gpu cache gauge are exposed; running, TTFT and the
# generation counter are missing -> those fields stay None.
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting to be processed.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting 0.0
# HELP vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc Percentage of GPU cache blocks currently in use.
# TYPE vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc gauge
vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc 0.25
# HELP vllm:cache_config_info Information of the KV cache configuration.
# TYPE vllm:cache_config_info gauge
vllm:cache_config_info 1.0
